main_text.p: hisce extremis diebus, humani ingenii petulantia immani, errores Pelagiani, So-ciniani, utinam non Arminiani & Epicurei, ut omnes promissiones novi fœderis sint tantum μορμολύκεια[?] verba & venti. Hoc imputamus Iefuitis vestris, hoc lafciviæ ingenii humani: quippe nullum magnum ingenium sine mixtura dementiæ. At si Cyni-cus ille philosophus, conspecto adole-scente vertiginoso, inculto, & profligato, præceptorem ipsius verberibus cædi jus-serit, vestri certe præceptores, Iefuitæ intelligo, quibus doctrinam vestram, & nova dogmata debetis, & vos cum illis digni estis, qui flagris cædamini. Inte-rim in promptu vobis erit coccysmus ve-ster fatalis, penes Deum me quidem esse, quo minus cædamini. Dicite enim per Deum immortalem, nec conscientias candidiores obtestari verebor, & qua Deo libertas salva esse posset, salvâ ve-stra scientiâ mediâ, & actuum contingentium decreto conditionato. Nam obtinente hoc dogmate, futuritionem habente, antecedenter ad Dei tum scien-tiam, tum decretum, omnes quotquot ærumnæ, mortalibus, ministerio cau-sarum

page.notes: Printed at the foot: "* 4" (page number) and the catchword "farum" at the lower right. The Greek word μορμολύκεια is hard to read at this scan resolution; the reading is uncertain and marked [?]. The printed spelling of "Socinianï" and "Iesuitas" was read from a low-contrast scan. The page has no marginal notes. The left edge shows only scan artefacts and was not transcribed.
